text: Oh, women are gonna abort their babies just because they're boys. Isn't that so cruel? Isn't that so evil? I don't know. Is it like just as cruel as you guys keeping a woman on life support just to use her body as an incubator or no? That doesn't bother you. Okay. I do have a quick little question though. What are you more mad about? Woman arguing her right to choose or that it's a boy. Would it change if it were men saying that they don't want to have a girl? All right. For those wondering what's going on here, let me give you some context. About a week ago, a post about aborting a baby simply because he's a boy went viral on TikTok. And I think it might be connected to the video you just saw. A girl posted three pictures. The first one shows a positive pregnancy test. The second one shows an ultrasound with the caption, the moment I found out it was a boy. And the third one shows what appears to be a planned parenthood appointment with the caption, the moment I booked that appointment. So the obvious implication is that she decided to have an abortion simply because she found out she was expecting a boy. Now, to be clear, we don't actually know whether this story is even real. It could easily be rage bait, especially considering that the account has only one post and the bio includes 16, which I assume refers to the person's age. But regardless, the post went viral, getting around 3.3 million views and almost half a million likes. And when I first saw it, I thought, great, just when you think TikTok content cannot get any worse. But then I opened the comment section and something unexpected happened. Something that actually restored a little bit of my faith in humanity. Plenty of men and women were pushing back against this perverse idea. And a lot of mothers started turning the comment section into what I can only describe as one of the most beautiful things I've seen on TikTok in a while. They started posting pictures of their sons with comments like, anyways, here's my beautiful baby boy. Basically, a whole wave of mothers proudly showing off their sons and expressing how much they love them. And look, I'm not going to pretend there weren't people supporting the original post. Of course there were. Almost half a million likes didn't appear out of nowhere. But seeing so many women pushing back against this idea, not with hatred, but simply by showing how much they love their baby boys was genuinely heartwarming. For a moment, I almost forgot I was on TikTok. But then of course, I came across the video you saw at the beginning and my faith in humanity was immediately put to another test. Because apparently, even the idea that aborting a child simply because he's a boy is wrong has now become controversial. So let's look at what this lady says about it. First, she asks whether it's just as cruel as keeping a woman on life support and using her body as an incubator. And this is what I find so mind-bogglingly disturbing about her response. You are the one comparing it to something you clearly seem to consider horrifying. So you apparently recognize just how cruel this idea could be. And yet, instead of condemning it, you're using that comparison to defend it? What kind of argument is that? Then she asks, what are you more mad about? A woman arguing her right to choose or that it's a boy? The second one, of course, that's literally the whole point. The issue here is not simply that a woman wants an abortion. The issue is that someone is presenting abortion based solely on the sex of the child as something acceptable or even worth celebrating. And those are two different discussions. You can support a woman's legal right to choose and still believe that choosing an abortion simply because the baby is a boy is morally disgusting. These positions are not mutually exclusive. And you don't even have to be against abortion to recognize the problem with sex-selective abortion. Of course, there are also people who oppose abortion altogether, but that's a much broader debate and it's not the specific issue I'm addressing here. And then she asks, would it change if it were men saying that they don't want to have a girl? No, absolutely not. If a man wanted a pregnancy terminated simply because the child was a girl, I would find that just as disturbing. It's not about boys being more valuable than girls or girls being more valuable than boys. It's about the idea of aborting a child simply because of their sex. Now, once again, we don't even know whether the original viral post was genuine, but the reactions to it are very real. And personally, I'm glad that so many women, including so many mothers, pushed back against this idea. Because regardless of what you think about abortion in general, I would hope we could at least agree that simply being a boy or a girl shouldn't be a reason to decide that a child is unwanted. And to all those mothers who filled the comment section with pictures of their sons, thank you. Because seeing those comments was genuinely one of the most heartwarming things I've come across on TikTok in a long time.
